description: Source code for HTTP/2 header validation logic within the quiche library, including header name/value validation, request/response header checks, and header parsing methods.

classes.name: HeaderValidator
classes.description: Class responsible for validating HTTP/2 headers, including pseudo-header validation, header field validation, and header block processing.

methods.name: StartHeaderBlock
methods.description: Initializes header validation state at the start of a new header block.

methods.name: ValidateSingleHeader
methods.description: Validates an individual header field (name and value) according to HTTP/2 rules.

methods.name: FinishHeaderBlock
methods.description: Checks if the collected pseudo-headers are valid for the header type (request, response, trailer).

methods.name: IsValidHeaderValue
methods.description: Checks if a header value contains only valid characters, considering obs-text option.

methods.name: IsValidAuthority
methods.description: Validates the authority header value against allowed characters.

methods.name: HandleContentLength
methods.description: Processes and validates the Content-Length header value, considering response status.

methods.name: ValidateAndSetAuthority
methods.description: Validates the authority header value and sets it if valid.
